about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: I'm a fullstack developer with 6 years of experience in scalable projects in document management (ECM), process automation (BPM), auctions, education, and fashion. My focus is on back-end (Node.js, NestJS, Java) and modern front-end (React, Next).
about.paragraph2: I have strong experience with complex integrations (ERP, external APIs), microservices architecture, AI-powered process automation, and intelligent agent development. I'm driven by delivering efficient solutions that reduce costs, scale products, and solve real problems.
about.paragraph3: Currently, I work at Superbid, where I directly contribute to the evolution of an online auction platform that processes thousands of bids, users, and critical events daily. I have a strong focus on performance, scalability, resilience, and code quality.

items.title: Fashion B2B Platform (Teceo)

items.title: Business Management Platform (Empreende Aqui)
items.description: I led the architectural migration from a monolithic C# system to microservices with Node.js on a platform for creating and managing companies 100% online. I developed services for dynamic PDF generation and automated email sending.

items.title: Educational Management Platform (Suporte Gerencial)
items.description: I developed the core of a large-scale educational management platform used by approximately 20 municipalities. I was responsible for school registration and grade control, class diaries, and critical academic routines. I also developed the CREA Pernambuco mobile app in React Native.

items.title: Predictive School Food Management System (SICAP)
items.description: I implemented an intelligent predictive system for school food sector management that analyzes consumption history per school, enabling demand forecasting based on real data. The system significantly reduced food waste costs.

I work on the development of the Gestor platform, focused on online auctions, processing thousands of bids, users, and critical events daily. I lead complex integrations of structured data (Excel), implementing ETL pipelines for automation and validation. I developed an AI solution for automatic spreadsheet analysis and integrated the Google Maps API for logistics routing. I use AI tools like Lovable, Cursor, and Claude Code to accelerate development.

I work on developing essential features for the ECM (Enterprise Content Management) and BPM (Business Process Management) platform of a US-based international company. I develop functionalities such as advanced document management, automated workflows, version control, and granular permissions. I also work on the AI agent integrated into the platform using Azure AI and on the company's mobile app development with React Native.

I worked as a Fullstack Developer in a B2B solution for the fashion sector, leading and implementing complex integrations with the TOTVS system (ERP). I created robust pipelines for API communication, performing RESTful and SOAP integrations, structured data processing, and automation of operational routines. All solutions were developed with a focus on resilience, decoupling, and performance. I worked in an agile environment, with application of Design Patterns, automated tests, and semantic versioning.

I worked as a Fullstack Developer on a platform for creating and managing companies 100% online, leading the architectural migration from a monolithic C# system to microservices with Node.js. I structured the architecture of independent services with a focus on scalability and maintainability, implementing communication via messaging (RabbitMQ) and REST APIs. I developed services for dynamic PDF document generation and automated email sending.

I worked on the development of a large-scale educational management platform, used by approximately 20 municipalities. I was responsible for developing the application core, focusing on school registration and grade control, class diaries, and academic routines. I also developed the CREA Pernambuco mobile app in React Native.

I collaborated on the development of an educational platform specialized in school food sector management, covering purchase control, inventory, validity, and acquisition planning. I was responsible for implementing an intelligent predictive system that analyzed consumption history per school, enabling demand forecasting based on real data. The module significantly reduced food waste costs.
